sanskrit: vyomātīta nirābhāsa spandanānandavarjitaśūnyaṃ śūnyaṃ tathā śūnyaṃ śūnyāśūnyāntarālinamtadgrāhyabhāvanātīta indriyātīta varjitamjāgratsvapnavinirmuktā sauṣuptāntaracāriṇīsarvatrāvasthitaṃ devaṃ mātrātītaṃ sunirmalampramāṇapratyaṃyātītaṃ gamāgamavivarjitamp. 94a) prabhuṃ sarvasya deveśa niśśeṣaṃ vada me prabhoanekabhedagūḍhārthaṃ śrutaṃ yaccendrajālakammantrārthagahanaṃ caiva tattvārthagahanaṃ tathābhrāntabudhirahaṃ deva bhrāmitā bahudāsanaiḥyena tajjñāyate satyaṃ dambhamāyāvivarjitammunibhirbrahmaviṣṇīśerindrasūryagaṇaistathāp. 94b) tatodhikaṃ yadastīti vadamasuranāyakaprasādaṃ kurusaṅkṣepād yenopāyena mucyatedhāraṇādhyānanirmuktaṃ yogatarkādidāhitamprasannātmā jagannātha vadetadbhaktavatsalanaiva tat kathitaṃ bhadre guroḥ śukrasya vānyapigopitaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ pāśāṇastho yadā śikhītadvacchiva manāmeyaṃ dṛśyate na ca dṛśyatesthālikāntarayogena hyantarlīnaḥ prapadyatetile tailaṃ drume cchāyā sauṣupte kulamadhyagamvicitrapakṣapakṣāḍhyaṃ vāṣpānte naiva dṛśyatena tasya rūpaṃ dṛśyeta āsvādaparivarjitamṣaḍrasaṃbhūmibhāge tu ākāśe vārṇasādhanamp. 95b) tadvatsamarasībhāvaṃ śivaṃ śāntaṃ jagatpatim

sanskrit: kenopāyena sogamyaḥ sarvopādhivivarjitaḥyena jñātena vai tṛptirjāyate tripurāntakabhramabhrāntiṃ parityajya grāhayet paramaṃ padamcintayā rahitaṃ cittaṃ niścittaṃ paramaṃ padamdaśavāyu sa vṛndāni daśasāhasrakāni cadaśasāhasranāḍyoghe saṃsthitaḥ kulamadhyagaḥmantrajālaṃ mahādurgaṃ kriyājālaṃ parityajaṣaṭcakraṃ ṣoḍaśādhāraṃ trilakṣyaṃ vyomapañcakamdvāsaptati sahasrāṇi nāḍivṛndaṃ parityajetp. 96b) gṛhyānandodbhave cakre klinnā saṃpīḍanena tuyoginī melakānandāttadā teṣāṃ prakāśitamtatrakāle mayāproktamānandaṃ jaghanesthitamtatrādhikaṃ tu parato yatra sṛṣṭirna jāyateānandojjhitamānandaṃ suṣupta iva saṃsthitambuddhīndriyavinirmuktaṃ kālākālavivarjitamp. 97a) na pramāṇaṃ prameyaśca na guṇo doṣa eva cana varṇaṃ varṇajātīnāṃ na geyaṃ vedanādināmna somaṃ sūryamityāhurhutāśanamapi priyena yakṣo na ca nāgendraṃ dharmādharmavivarjitamna bījaṃ vanavṛkṣaṃ vā auṣadhaṃ na ca vidyategamāgamairna lipyeta abyucchinnapravāhanamstrīsukhānandanirmuktaṃ viṣayānandadūṣakamvyomānandarasonmattaṃ bodhānandapariplutamvyomasthaṃ vyomarūpasthaṃ vyomātmāvyomasambhavamtasya sṛṣṭiḥ sthitā cānte yo jānāti sa tatvavit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00266 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kriyājñānaṃ tathecchā ca abyucchinnaṃ pravartatetata evāgataṃ piṇḍaṃ tatraiva ca sa gacchatip. 98a) līyate tatra vai sthāne punastatra samāgamamādau tu hyakhilaṃ sarvaṃ paścāt sṛṣṭiḥ pravartateśivātprasūyate piṇḍaṃ śive piṇḍaṃ punarvrajetyo sā vatīṃndriyagrāhyaḥ sarvavyāpī parāparaḥśivaśakti parityāgānna piṇḍaṃ piṇḍabandhanamyadā līyanti sarvetra tadā liṅgamudāhṛtamp. 98b) yadā hyekatra tritayaṃ nityato yo pi bhāvayetna ca lipyati pāpena karmaṇā manasāgirāṃsarvaṃ śivātmakaṃ viśvaṃ yā kriyā sā śivātmikāaśuddhā nityamucchuṣmā saṅkīrṇo yaḥ sa bhairavaḥbrahmādyāḥ śivaparyantaṃ pañcadravyāḥ prakīrtitāḥbrahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśśiva eva caete malā hyadhobhāge ūrdhvaṃ nityaṃ pradīpakaḥpañcaite devatā mūle kulaliṅge pratiṣṭhitāḥśukraṃ śleṣmaṃ śirolomā ye cānye cāṅga santatautatrasthaṃ paramaṃ sākṣāt tṛṇakāṣṭhe viśeṣataḥsūryānandaṃ rasānandaṃ samānandamudānataḥahaṅkārotha navamaṃ daśamaṃ tu dhanañjayamsarvato devatāmārge brahmādyaṣṭau prakīrtitāḥpavano yāmadaivatyaḥ śaṅkaraścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥvyāne tu ca?krakī devī nāge tu bhujagī parādevadatte ahaṅkārī nityarūpā dhanañjayenābhi cakre sthitāścānyāḥ koṭyo dvāsaptatiḥ kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00266 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirāmayaḥ paraṃ śūnyo nābhimadhye virājaterakṣamānastakaṃ piṇḍaṃ vinodārthe vijṛmbhatesahasralakṣaṃ koṭyābhamicchāśakti pradīpakamaneka viśvarūpeṇa eko * * *? rañjanaḥsopadeśaṃ paraṃ śāntaṃ sampradāyaṃ sunirmalamlabhate nirmalaṃ bhāvaṃ madaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjitamtadā prāpya gurusthānādvaktrāvaktrena vedayetbhāvapūrvaprayogena dharmādharmakṣayeṇa tusarvāvasthaṃ śivaṃ jñātvā kona mucyeta bandhanāt?nirupādhi vihīnātmā? kriyākāraṇavarjitamantardeha gataṃ cittaṃ cañcalaṃ capalaṃ tathāp. 101a) yena vijñātamātreṇa bhavate cchinnasaṃśayaḥyadi bandhātmakaṃ viśvaṃ tadā mokṣaṃ prapadyatebaddhosau svavikalpena na ca bandhaṃ śivasya hibandhaṃ caiva na tasyāsti vibhutvāt sarvataḥ śivaḥsatyākāraṃ ca deveśi na baddho na ca mucyatevibhīṣikā mahāraudrā narakādi bhayāvahāp. 101b) pūrvaiva kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaṃ sarvagataṃ śivamsarvaṃ śivamayaṃ bhadre paunaḥ puṇyena kīrtitamsadāśiva mayecchā ca na kriyā parataḥ śivaḥyena yena hi mārgeṇa yā dṛśe tādṛśena vāyena vijñātamātreṇa na bhūyaḥ parivartanamtadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣveka manāḥ priyebahuvādaratācāra parasparavirodhataḥyadā tvekākinaṃ devi naramāmi kulāntike
source_edition: Muktabodha M00266 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekākī paramo devaḥ śaktyā saha tu krīḍatitena rūpaṃ svayaṃ dṛṣṭamarūpaṃ darśayet tathāeko devo na cānyosti kiṃ vā dvandvena kāraṇamadvaitaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dvaitaṃ nāsti mahāprabhoyathā tilāṅkure bījamūrdhvaṃ dṛśyanti tāṃstilānphalaṃ bījaṃ tathā snehaṃ paśyanti tilasaṃmatamevaṃ puryaṣṭake devi śivaṃ māyā vinaṃvibhumśivaṃ sarvagataṃ dhyātvā icchāvecchāntarālinamācāreṇa tu kiṃ kāryaṃ ke pāśāḥ kaḥ paśuḥ smṛtaḥjñātvā jñeyaṃ gurusthānāt sākṛnnirchanti lakṣaṇampralīyati tadābhyāsāt snehavarti kṣayāntarepatitāḥ pralayaṃ yānti tadvachūnye cidātmakamdhāmaniryāsakāle tu kramācchītalatāṃ vrajetśāntendha na śikhāṃ yadvat pradīptastatra līyatesauṣumṇe indriyāartheṣu nopalabdhiḥ pradṛśyatep. 104a) vṛddhakāle tu bālatvaṃ piṇḍasthosya na dṛśyatesarvaṃ vyomārṇave līnaṃ na kiñcidapi cintayetvyomākāraṃ sadābhāve tadbhāvabhāvanāśanammuktaścarati yuktātmā māruto gagane yathāka *? mala kavanmuktiḥ pratyakṣamupalabhyateūrdhvotkrāntiṃ parityajya adhaḥ saṃpīḍanaṃ tathāakleśabhāve vijñānaṃ nityaṃ sarvagataṃ śivamvyomābhāsaṃ tvayā coktaṃ sthānoddeśena kiṃ ca vāetanme saṃśayaṃ ghoramaghoravacanaṃ vadakāṇḍilīkulabhoktṛtvaṃ karmasthānā valī sthitam

sanskrit: mucyamānaṃ tu taṃ sthānaṃ na yuktiriti niścayamp. 105a) martyā?nandamayaṃ tacca icchāśaktiradhiṣṭhitamrūpasthamīśvaraṃ tatvaṃmavalambaṃ śivaṃ priyenirbhrāntaṃ sarvanirmuktamagocara pade sthitamnaṣṭe dagdhātmake dehe kasya piṇḍaṃ padaṃ kramampralīne śūnyamārgeṇa kuto dānaṃ kutaḥ kriyāviditesmin pare tatve sarve?vajīdvirgā?tayaḥkrodhaṃ kālāgni rudraṃ vai mohaṃ māyā tathā priyeduḥkhaḥ saṃsārabhadhandānmaraṇaṃ? bhairavālayeaṭanaṃ tu rathaṃ divyaṃ niṣṭhānta kālabhairavamadṛṣṭavigrahāśaktiravyucchinna pravāhinī?*? rmecchā ca śivecchā ca kriyecchā tritayaḥ umeusvitā? pañca?rangaiśca? nānārūpaṃ vipadyatemantrā hi devatānāma koṭī koṭirasaṅkhyayāpañcaite bhakṣayennityaṃ na pañcarahitaṃ kvacitekatrapā?dataṃ sarvaṃ strīpumāṃstiyagyonayaḥhradatīrtha nadī nadya udyānaṃ tṛṇagocaramvaktre vaktrena sā dṛśyaṃ pituḥ putrasya bhāminivṛkṣaṃ vakṣena sādṛśyaṃ toyaṃ toye tathaiva canadī nadyānamādṛśyaṃ puṣpe puṣpaṃ tathāviduḥramate jṛmbhate devo modate vadate kriyāmkvacidvyādhi mayaṃ rudre kvaciddirghā * * * *?mkvacidvidyādharo rūpī kvacinmūrkha virūpiṇam?nā?cidraviśaśītejaḥ kvacinmaraṇajīvitaḥp. 107a) pañcabhūtavibhāgena avibhāgena cetasā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00266 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śuddhāśuddhaṃ na va * * * * * * * *? sthitaḥekato brahmapadavī eko *?va umāpatiḥbrahmasarvamayabhadre jñātavyaṃ niścayātmakamna yajñadānadātṛtvairna tīrthagamanena cana ca kṛcchrāti kṛcchreṇa na ca cāndrāyaṇena vāniśā?yā * *? cittaṃ nirudvegaṃ sadākurusanghe? hatapapīṭhādyairaṣṭa? * * *? bhitaṃ kulamvāma?dakṣiṇamadhyasthaṃ kulakaulāntarālinamsarvaṃ dehānna *? līnaṃ yadhoktaṃ pūrvacoditamyaṃ yaṃ bhogāvṛtaṃ cittaṃ taṃ taṃ manasi dāpayettasya tasya na cotpatti kharūpī sarvato mukhaḥhṛtāśano yamaḥ so hi darśanādaghanāśanaḥsa?dehaḥ śuddhi māyāti kiṃ? punarnikaṭānvitam* * *? tiṣṭhate tasya melakaṃ *?śi *? rvṛteiti śrī ra * sye * de * *? si pa sa rṇa caturtha uddeśaḥsā * *? hṛdi me grāhyaṃ hyagrāhyaṃ paśu bhārataḥ?p. 108b) kasyecchā trividhe kāle dṛśyate ca hyanekadhātasya bhedaṃ kathaṃ deva dṛśyate bhuvana trayaṃnagrahaṃ nigrahaṃ krū?raṃ bhaktirvā śāṭhyameva vāmṛtyusaṃhārakasyaivaṃ kovāmṛtyustvayādhikaḥnityoditasya devasya kasya buddhi?kṣayo bhavetsa devatāstathā tīrthā guhyāyatanasaṃsthitāḥsāgarā?vividhā bhūtā ye cānye krimisambhavāḥpīṭhopapīṭha sandoha nirjharānirjarāstathāmṛtadehasya piṇḍasya na kiñcidupalabhyate

sanskrit: jijñāsārahitaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo nirākṛtiḥnirālambaṃ na cotsāhaṃ śūnyabhūtaṃ śivātmakamkṣubdhāśūnyālayāsaṃjñā tasmāt piṇḍaṃ prapadyateakṣubdharūpanityasthā vyomābhāsā kulāntavitnirbhrāntaṃ yena vā jñātaṃ tena jñātaṃ tu bhairavamnirā?kṛti vilīnāsā tadvaddehī nabho pamaḥśanaiḥ śanaista tasyaiva pariśeṣaḥ pravartatecidarthavi?bhavaṃ sarvaṃ jñānamajñānagocaramsvasthire parame dhāmni śivaśakti layāntaretatra yāti idaṃ viśvaṃ yatkiñcit pāñcabhautikamekadā bahurūpeṇa bhairavāṣṭāṣṭa cāṣṭakamkiṅkarāgaṇagandharvā ṛṣayopsarasastathākinnarā bhūpiśācāśca krimikīṭasarīsṛpāḥtathā cāṣṭottara śataṃ ta?tva tattvāntarālinamevaṃ saṃsāravibhavaṃ satkṛtaṃ hyumayāmahap. 110b) sarvaṃ sarvamayaṃ cāhaṃ tatra madhye tvayāmahasarvaṃ sa?marasaghoraṃ śaktisaṅgamasāgaramyadā palīyate dvābhyāṃ viśvaṃ na saha bhāminina kiñciccintanāddevi na naśyati na muhyatinopalabdhirna caivāsti nā bhāva na? vikalpanākevalaṃ śūnyatā nādaṃ dvitīyo nāsti niścayaḥśukrasya noditaṃ pūrvamasurārthaṃ na bodhakesarvatra saṃsthitohīśaḥ kaśśodhyaḥ kaśca siddhyatiguruśiṣya krameṇātha kiṃ kāryaṃ kiṃ prayojanambhrāntimutpādyate deva bhrāmitāṃhaṃ tu śaṅkara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00266 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa vikalpasya jantośca jatrasya samalasya cap. 111b) bhāvametā dṛśaṃ kṛtvā yā dṛśaṃ kathitaṃ tavaāhvānakāraṇaṃ sthānamārurukṣuṣu darśayetdhyāna pūjādikaṃ tacca sarvaṃ saṅkalpasaṃbhavambhāvābhāvavinirmuktaṃ muktācāreṇasañcaretanyathā śāstra pāṇḍityaṃ vedagarveṣu garvitāḥp. 112a) anyathā hyopadeśaṃ tu bhrānti yuktāstathānyathāanyathā paramāśaktirlokāḥ kliśyanti cānyathāna tarkaṃ trāṇamityāhustrāṇārthaṃ paramaṃ śivamdhātu dārumayaṃ liṅgaṃ pāṣāṇorthaṃ tu hemajamna cātra kurute trāṇaṃ caitanyasya acetanamp. 112b) advaitabhāvaṃ deveśi trāṇārthaṃ sarvato bhavetvināvijñānasaundaryāt guruṇājñāpito yadāadvaitaṃ sādhayennityaṃ sarvāvasthaṃ śivātmakamadvaitaṃ suthiraṃ mokṣamadvaitaṃ bhogalakṣaṇamdvaitādvaitavidhirnāsti praviśecchāmbhave padeyadyapi syān mahādvaitaṃ dvaitaṃ vande kulāraṇīeṣāṃ madhye na cādvaitametacchāstrasya nirṇayamnāmaparyaṅkabhedena ekatvaṃ caivamekadhābhramanti jñānasandigdhā ajñānapadamohitāḥkecidvadanti haṃsosau kecit praṇavaprāṇinamkecicchaktiparānandaṃ paraṃ bhāvaṃ bhajantitekecicchaivaṃ tathā daivaṃ kecijjyotistu golakamkecit mātṛkalābindu asparśonādatastathākecidvadanti cātmānaṃ paramātmani saṃsthitam
